Shell(node -e "const r=require(process.env.COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD+'/lh-report.json'); const a=r.audits; ['render-blocking-resources','font-display','unused-javascript','bootup-time','mainthread-work-breakdown','server-response-time','lcp-lazy-loaded','prioritize-lcp-image','third-party-summary'].forEach(k=>{const x=a[k]; if(x) console.log(k+':', x.displayValue||JSON.stringify(x.details&&x.details.items?x.details.items.slice(0,4):null));});")
